entries.2016d97a907c7257: The company's corporate philosophy is “Creating Rich and Comfortable Living.” As its medium-term management strategy, the company states that it will actively carry out a business in which it selects high-quality items from the real estate project information and renewable energy-related investment information offered, secures the necessary funds through flexible fundraising, carries out real estate development and the adjustment of rights relating to solar and biomass power plants, obtains licenses and approvals and similar, and then sells to operators. As priority issues, the company cites four items: expanding the business base and strengthening earnings capacity, strengthening business fundraising capacity, strengthening internal management systems, and securing and developing human resources.

entries.37cdd176a575e201: This is a business model that generates revenue by selectively acquiring and developing real estate and renewable energy projects and selling them to operators and developers, including through joint business arrangements.
